title: Genshin Impact Artifact Stats, Rolls, and CV Scaling
summary: Detailed breakdown of artifact main stat pools per slot, substat rolls distributions, RNG weighting, and mathematical formula for calculating CRIT Value (CV).
content:
# Genshin Impact Artifact Stats, Rolls, and CV Scaling

## Main Stat Slots
Artifacts consist of 5 gear slots. Certain slots have fixed main stats, while others draw from a random pool:

| Slot | Fixed Main Stat | Eligible Random Main Stats |
|------|-----------------|---------------------------|
| **Flower of Life** | HP (Flat) | None |
| **Plume of Death** | ATK (Flat) | None |
| **Sands of Eon** | None | ATK%, DEF%, HP%, Energy Recharge%, Elemental Mastery |
| **Goblet of Eonothem** | None | Elemental DMG Bonus% (Pyro/Hydro/etc.), Physical DMG Bonus%, ATK%, DEF%, HP%, Elemental Mastery |
| **Circlet of Logos** | None | CRIT Rate%, CRIT DMG%, Healing Bonus%, ATK%, DEF%, HP%, Elemental Mastery |

---

## Substat Generation and Rolls
- A 5-star artifact starts with either **3 or 4 substats**.
- An artifact cannot have a substat that matches its main stat.
- At levels 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20, the artifact either gains a new substat (if it started with 3) or upgrades a random existing substat (if it started with 4) by a random roll tier.

### Substat Roll Tiers (5-Star Artifacts)
Upgrades are drawn randomly from four potential tiers (70%, 80%, 90%, or 100% of maximum value):

| Substat | Min Roll (70%) | Mid-Low (80%) | Mid-High (90%) | Max Roll (100%) |
|---------|----------------|----------------|----------------|-----------------|
| **CRIT Rate%** | 2.7% | 3.1% | 3.5% | 3.9% |
| **CRIT DMG%** | 5.4% | 6.2% | 7.0% | 7.8% |
| **ATK%** | 4.1% | 4.7% | 5.3% | 5.8% |
| **HP%** | 4.1% | 4.7% | 5.3% | 5.8% |
| **DEF%** | 5.1% | 5.8% | 6.6% | 7.3% |
| **Energy Recharge%** | 4.5% | 5.2% | 5.8% | 6.5% |
| **Elemental Mastery** | 16 | 19 | 21 | 23 |
| **Flat ATK** | 14 | 16 | 18 | 19 |
| **Flat HP** | 209 | 239 | 269 | 299 |
| **Flat DEF** | 16 | 19 | 21 | 23 |

---

## CRIT Value (CV) Calculation
To evaluate the offensive quality of an artifact, theorycrafters calculate its **CRIT Value (CV)**. Since 1% of CRIT Rate is statistically worth 2% of CRIT DMG based on stat allocation ratios:

$$\text{CV} = (2 \times \text{CRIT Rate \%}) + \text{CRIT DMG \%}$$

*Note: Main stats are excluded from CV calculations; only substats are counted.*

### CV Standards (For individual flower/plume/sands/goblet):
- **Low Investment (Below 20 CV)**: Needs improvement.
- **Decent (20–30 CV)**: Solid mid-game or support artifact.
- **High Investment (30–40 CV)**: Very strong artifact; hard to upgrade.
- **God Roll (40+ CV)**: Extremely rare, near-perfect substat rolls.
